---
title: "Bayer scientist panel — Tue Nov 17"
---

On **Tuesday November 17** (3:10 PM, Veihmeyer 212), scientists from Bayer
join us for a panel on careers in plant science and genetics. Two things to
do before then:

## 1. Send your questions by Friday November 6

**[Submit questions for the panel](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSORgrVXKUHr7yeGQqCUabUkruNa1xvi8qcTLtKx8VT1JyYg/viewform)**

Anything goes: how they got their job, what a normal day looks like, the
science they work on, what they wish they'd known as undergrads. Adding your
name is optional. I'll send the questions to the panel so they can prepare.

## 2. Read the networking guide

[A Beginner's Guide to Networking](https://hbr.org/2023/03/a-beginners-guide-to-networking)
(Rakshitha Arni Ravishankar, *Harvard Business Review*, March 2023). If the HBR page asks you to sign in, read the [PDF copy](files/networking_guide.pdf). The
panel is a chance to meet people who do this work, so come ready to talk to them.
